members.title: Team Members
members.description: Invite teammates to handle feedback together — roles decide what each person can do.
members.emptyDescription: Invite a teammate to start handling user feedback together
members.rolePermissions: Role permissions: Owners manage the organization and members; Admins manage project configuration and members; Members can view and handle feedback.

roleHints.owner: Full access, can manage organization settings and members
roleHints.admin: Can manage feedback, project configuration and members

inviteModal.title: Invite member
inviteModal.description: Invite links are valid for 72 hours. Invitees can join after setting a password through the link.

inviteResultModal.title: Email isn't configured — share the invite link manually
inviteResultModal.description: Email delivery isn't configured yet. Copy the link below and send it to the invitee.
inviteResultModal.linkHint: The invitee joins automatically after opening the link and setting a password. You can also configure email delivery in System settings to send invitations automatically.

removeModal.title: Remove member
removeModal.body: Once removed, this member can no longer access the organization's feedback and configuration. Their activity history is kept.

tags.title: Tag Management
tags.description: Tags label feedback and can be used to filter the feedback list, helping the team categorize and track issues.

newCard.title: Create tag
newCard.description: Start from a common preset, or customize the name and color.

tags.emptyDescription: Start from a preset above, or create a custom tag

deleteModal.title: Delete tag
deleteModal.bodyInUse: This tag is used by {{count}} feedback items. Deleting it will remove the tag from those items.
